neighbours.label: the point at the end of a negated or limiting statement where a contrast is about to follow ('I wouldn't buy it myself, | but ...'); the same statement made affirmatively stays quiet
fire: I wouldn't cook this dish for guests, but it's fine for a quick lunch.
The new laptop won't be as quiet as the old one, but it is much faster.
She doesn't enjoy long meetings, but she always comes prepared.
We couldn't afford a hotel by the beach, but the cabin was lovely.
This tent won't keep you as warm as a cabin, but it packs down small.
He isn't the strongest swimmer on the team, but he never gives up.
I wouldn't call the film a masterpiece, but I enjoyed every minute.
The bakery doesn't open on Sundays, but it stays open late on Fridays.
quiet: I cook this dish for guests and it's also fine for a quick lunch.
The new laptop is as quiet as the old one and much faster.
She enjoys long meetings and always comes prepared.
We booked a hotel by the beach and the room was lovely.
This tent keeps you as warm as a cabin and packs down small.
He is the strongest swimmer on the team and never gives up.
I would call the film a masterpiece and I enjoyed every minute.
The bakery opens on Sundays and stays open late on Fridays.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.45 on the comma/last word of a negated or limiting clause before 'but/however'; affirmative versions below 0.1
notes: Card: peaks on ',' after negated clauses ('I wouldn't purchase my own copy, but', 'I don't, besides'), ' haven|'t', 'won't be as quick', ' more' in 'There's more to this story, but', ' few'. The + pole suppresses ' but'. Probe: 'won't be as fast on hills as the older bike, but' 0.431, 'wouldn't buy this phone for myself, but' 0.382, 'There's more to this story' 0.315, 'haven't talked about the ending yet, however' 0.239; affirmative counterparts 0.039-0.054.
